name: Safe area guides
author: Lienzo UI
description: Adds locked, translucent guides for phone notches and home bars, or a 5% title-safe margin, and removes them when you are done.

commands.name: Add phone safe-area guides
commands.description: Marks the notch, corner and home bar areas (landscape or portrait, depending on the design).

commands.name: Add title-safe margin guides
commands.description: Marks a 5% margin on every side.

commands.name: Remove guides
commands.description: Deletes the guide panels added by this plugin.
